source_evidence: src/designwin.h declares the real16-byte RECT stats_rect_ at+B3C; draw_vehicle stores its four edges in original order and tour7 passes its address for DESTOURSTATS. Both configured native compiler-layout trials observe tagRECT at+B3C. Original producer/caller operands and next member+B4C support the extent-neutral interpretation; descriptive name is not a recovered debug spelling.

All six external consumer object deltas are independently reproduced from unchanged master source using only the current DesignWin header overlay; unchanged replicas reproduce master. The reviewed draw_vehicle delta only exchanges the two operands of the same commutative addition. These observations explain differences but do not turn failed physical comparisons or unknown linked preservation into passes.
